# **Jared Qs and Discussions**

The workflow is as follows

Parent inquiry → digital intake (forms) → provider matching → enrolment → documents → attendance (provider) (to send to J) → parent communicationm (emails or newsletters) → provider timesheet (send to J my form) → agency reporting/payroll.

Eventual finalized parent portal/app could show today’s attendance, provider/home information, upcoming closures, forms requiring signatures, invoices or fee information, developmental/program updates, meal information and agency announcements. (Options for Later)

**Primary goals**  
Give families a simple intake and registration experience on phones and computers.  
Give staff a shared admissions dashboard and clear next actions.  
Track provider availability and help staff identify appropriate possible matches.  
Store structured enrolment data so staff can search, filter, report, and avoid retyping information.  
Preserve signed forms and supporting documents as controlled records.  
Support private-pay and municipal subsidy pathways, including pending approvals and exceptions.  
Allow the agency to change questions, workflow rules, reminders, and chatbot handoff behaviour without a software rebuild.

**Phase two (CRM build) Features and Must haves.**  
**(brightwheel or lillio UI as base to start or Jared can recommend) **

**One-person command centre:** One screen showing everything requiring your attention today.  
**Delegation:** Assign tasks to staff without giving them access to every record.  
**Permission levels:** Owner, Administrator, Home Visitor and read-only roles.  
**Complete admissions stages:** Lead → Screening → Documents Needed → Ready to Match → Matching → Enrolled, plus Waitlisted, Withdrawn and Declined.  
**Multiple children:** One family record must support multiple children, guardians, schedules and providers.  
**Critical alerts:** Allergies, medical plans, missing documents and approaching subsidy/service-expiry dates.  
**Automated reminders:** Incomplete forms, missing documents and expiring records.  
**Audit history:** Record who viewed, changed, approved or downloaded information.  
**Ownership and backups:** You should own the Firebase account, database, files, domain configuration and source code.  
**Future expansion:** Confirm whether attendance, parent check-in/out, weekly signatures, provider timesheets, payroll exports and parent communications are Phase 2—not silently assumed to be included.  
Dedicated Document Dashboard

The most important design principle is: **the CRM should tell you what needs attention instead of requiring you to search for it.** That is what will make running the agency largely by yourself realistic.
